description: County courthouse pins for the MapLibre map page (phase P5). Every url must be an official host (see scripts/validate.mjs OFFICIAL_HOSTS). Pins never carry identity fields and never imply ticket search.

address.description: Street address of the building the pin marks.

county.description: County name; must exist in data/states/<ST>.yaml.

name.description: Display name shown in the map popup.

state.description: Two-letter code; must match the file name.

url.description: Official page for this pin's agency. No identity fields are collected on our side.

title: TicketRouter map pins
